mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 270.5 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 270.5), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) combined with declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declining), or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below -0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is rising (month-over-month), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) exceeding 1600 thousand units indicates a strong housing market, correlating with robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
